scope: Bounded material-operation inventory: six material Agent-Native IDs plus reviewed actions in the five listed mounted sources. The checker traverses the current UI route/import graph and fails every write or unresolved API call outside this inventory until a source-backed classification is added. The remaining UI calls are not presumed non-material.

operations.reason: The current Human Support case surface uses the canonical customerSupportCaseService owner; its role and case-state controls remain Human-only.
This UI action reviews and publishes a previously proposed private memory share as a Human. It is not the Agent proposal operation and must retain the distinct Human review authority.
The mounted setup wizard authors a Human-owned setup draft. The manifest operation creates an Agent proposal; treating the wizard as equivalent would erase the proposal/review boundary.
The mounted UI publishes a reviewed Workflow revision as a Human. The manifest operation only prepares the exact publication request for confirmation, so these are related but distinct operations.
The mounted Task assignment control and Native Runner operation converge on the issue update and dispatch handoff owners; authorization remains checked by those owners.
The Human hire/setup wizard is a separate Human publication flow. The Native Runner operation requests a hire and cannot publish or inherit the wizard's Human authority.

uiOnlyActions.reason: Human review publishes an Agent-proposed share through the memory publication owner; it is intentionally not an Agent operation.
Human publication of a reviewed setup remains a separate owner action from an Agent proposal or Native Runner hire request.
The Human publish command commits a reviewed revision through workflowService; the Agent manifest operation only prepares a confirmation request and cannot publish.

Human stops the current heartbeat run; final status and recovery remain governed by heartbeat and Task owners. The exact client route is post:`/heartbeat-runs/${runId}/cancel`.
